translation: These several statements are all the subtle purport of the river chariot of the alchemists. But the medicine and the fire timing have their own separate transmission. Wang Haizang said: Zhang Pingshu said that lead is the correct qi of the north, the true yang born at the first point, the mother of the elixir; its creature is the tortoise, that is, the two yin of kan, the axis of the earth.
